title: New Chess.com members per month: pandemic baseline vs post-Queen's Gambit

source.name: Reporting on Chess.com signup growth around The Queen's Gambit release (Oct 23, 2020)
source.publisher: Chess.com / contemporaneous press coverage (Sportico, NBC News)

notes: Chess.com was adding roughly 1 million new members a month during the 2020 pandemic lockdowns; in November 2020, the month after Netflix's The Queen's Gambit premiered, it added about 2.8 million.
